GOOD MORNING, HAPPY CAPE COD, FIGHTIN’ FIFTH![image][image]It’s going to be a beautiful, bright and sunshiny Sunday on Cape Cod, and I can’t think of a better way to spend the morning than supporting our K9 heroes! [image][image]TODAY IS THE FIRST ANNUAL K9 5K IN BOURNE![image][image]Join us at Bourne Middle School for opening ceremonies at 9 AM, with the 5K kicking off at 10 AM. It’s a loop course through the neighborhood, starting and finishing right at the school.[image][image]We’ll have prizes, our hero K9s, K9 handlers, and a whole lot of support for the men, women, and four-legged heroes who serve and protect us every day.[image][image]These dogs put their lives on the line for us. This is our chance to say THANK YOU to these incredible K9s and their handlers and show them how much our community appreciates everything they do.[image][image]I’m proud to support our K9s and their handlers, and I hope you’ll join us for this special event.[image][image]SEE YOU AT 9 AM IN BOURNE![image]🇺🇸💙[image]#RepX #Fightin5th #ProudAmerican #ServiceBeforeSelf #CommonSenseLeadership #Police #Military #K9 #Barnstable #Bourne #Sandwich #CapeCod #Massachusetts #MaPoli #ForSean [image]K9 PTSD Center[image]Healing Dakota[image]K9 Flexx and Retired/Police K9 Mr. Warner.[image]K9 Kitt Foundation[image]Nero Our K9 Hero[image]Rehoboth K9 Edo[image]Yarmouth Police Dept.[image]Braintree Police Department[image]Springfield Police Department[image]Massachusetts State Police[image]The Nicholas G. GOOD MORNING, HAPPY SATURDAY, CAPE COD! [image][image]Early voting in person begins TODAY all across the Commonwealth, including right here in the three great towns I’m proud to represent: Barnstable, Bourne, and Sandwich![image][image]Your vote matters! Whether you’ve already voted by mail, plan to vote early in person, or will vote on Election Day, November 3rd, please take the time to make your voice heard.[image][image]I’d be honored to earn your vote so I can continue serving you, our communities, and the Commonwealth.[image][image]Proud to be your Representative in the Great Fightin’ Fifth![image][image]Have a GREAT Cape Cod Saturday! God bless! THANK YOU! [image][image]Today, while I was out putting up campaign signs in Buzzards Bay, my heart stopped when I saw two little dogs with leashes running loose in the street near Mezza Luna Restaurant on the busy main road.[image][image]I pulled over, jumped out, and tried to catch them before they got hit by a car.[image][image]Another man came running over, and when I asked if they were his dogs, he said, “No, I’m trying to catch them, too!” Then a wonderful waitress from Mezza Luna came running out to help.[image][image]The three of us worked together to guide the dogs safely back toward the parking lot. Thankfully, we spotted a yellow pickup truck with the driver’s door wide open, and the dogs went right back inside. We shut the door and made sure they were safe.[image][image]I went inside Leo’s Restaurant next door and asked if anyone owned the yellow truck. A gentleman jumped right up and came outside. He was so thankful to have his two dogs back! He explained that the door on his older truck had apparently come open for the second time.[image][image]I didn’t get everyone’s names, but I want to say THANK YOU to that gentleman and the wonderful waitress who jumped in to help. We all worked together, and those two little dogs are safe tonight![image][image]That’s how Buzzards Bay rolls! Great people, two great restaurants side by side, and folks who stop what they’re doing to help others. Today, that meant helping save two little dogs.[image][image]Have a wonderful Saturday night, everyone. Hope to see you tomorrow morning at 9 AM at Bourne Middle School for the K9 PTSD Run in the great town of Bourne![image][image]Dogs rule! 🇺🇸❤️🐶🐶🐾🐾😊[image]#RepX #Fightin5th #ProudAmerican #CommonSenseLeadership #ProudAmerican #Barnstable #Bourne #Sandwich #BuzzardsBay #Dogs #CapeCod #Massachusetts #MaPoli[image]MEZZA LUNA RESTAURANT[image]K9 PTSD Center
